title: N701 Water Hyacinth Armchair
description: A sculptural armchair handwoven from sustainably harvested water hyacinth over a solid acacia wood frame. Each piece is crafted by artisans in the Mekong Delta, blending organic texture with architectural form. The naturally variegated tones of the weave create a warm, tactile surface that softens any interior.

images.alt: N701 Water Hyacinth Armchair — front view
N701 Armchair in a Scandinavian-style room

specs.material: 100% Natural Water Hyacinth / Solid Acacia Wood Frame
specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight and humidity. Apply natural beeswax annually to maintain the weave's suppleness.

title: L120 Water Hyacinth Storage Basket
description: A versatile storage basket woven from tightly coiled water hyacinth fibres. Designed for both retail display and home organisation, it pairs structural rigidity with a soft, organic surface. Integrated cotton rope handles allow for easy carrying.

images.alt: L120 Storage Basket — on wall shelf in sunlight
L120 Storage Basket — kitchen counter use
L120 Storage Basket — minimalist shelf display

specs.material: 100% Natural Water Hyacinth / Cotton Rope Handles
specs.care: Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth. Do not saturate. Reshape while damp if needed.

title: P220 Water Hyacinth Pendant Lamp
description: A pendant light fixture with a shade handwoven from fine water hyacinth strands. When lit, the weave casts intricate, warm shadow patterns across the surrounding space. Compatible with standard E27 fittings and EU electrical standards.

images.alt: P220 Pendant Lamp — glowing in interior
P220 Pendant Lamp — close-up weaving pattern
P220 Pendant Lamps — three in a row against gray wall

specs.dimensions: Ø 45 × H 38 cm, Cord 150 cm adjustable
specs.material: 100% Natural Water Hyacinth / Metal Frame / Cotton Cord
specs.packaging: Individual carton with protective insert, 1 pc per box
specs.care: Dust regularly with a soft brush. Avoid moisture. Use LED bulbs only (max 12W).

title: C340 Water Hyacinth Coffee Table
description: A low coffee table featuring a water hyacinth woven tabletop framed in solid reclaimed teak. The contrast between the smooth wood edge and the textured woven surface creates a centrepiece that grounds any seating arrangement.

images.alt: C340 Coffee Table — bright modern living room
C340 Coffee Table — styled living room setting
C340 Coffee Table — minimalist interior with woven chair

specs.material: 100% Natural Water Hyacinth / Reclaimed Solid Teak Frame
specs.packaging: Flat-pack carton with foam corners, 1 pc per box
specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Use coasters for beverages. Re-oil the teak frame annually.

title: S450 Water Hyacinth Shelf Unit
description: A modular shelving unit with water hyacinth woven back panels set in a solid wood frame. The combination of open storage and textured panelling makes it equally suited to retail merchandising and residential library use.

images.alt: S450 Shelf Unit — with books and tea mug
S450 Shelf Unit — with wicker basket in sunlight

specs.material: 100% Natural Water Hyacinth / Solid Acacia Wood Frame
specs.packaging: Flat-pack carton, hardware kit included, 1 set per box
specs.care: Dust with a dry cloth. Secure to wall using the included anti-tip bracket.

title: R560 Water Hyacinth Area Rug
description: A flat-woven area rug made from dried water hyacinth fibres pressed and stitched into a durable, reversible mat. Its natural tonal variations create a subtle geometric pattern that complements both contemporary and rustic interiors.

images.alt: R560 Area Rug — woven texture detail
R560 Area Rug — close-up surface pattern
R560 Area Rug — natural woven straw texture

specs.packaging: Rolled in protective sleeve, 1 pc per roll
specs.care: Vacuum on low setting. Spot clean with a damp cloth. Roll, do not fold, for storage.
